note.question: What determines a two-step data-analytic approach to the promotion planning for mobile applications (apps)?
note.overview: In this paper, we propose a two-step data-analytic approach to the promotion planning for mobile applications (apps). In the first step, we use historical sales data to estimate the app demand model and quantify the effect of price promotions on download volume. Based on the empirically estimated demand model, we propose a moving planning window heuristic to construct a promotion policy.
